tagline: We help founders shape their product, not just build it.
brief: A product engineering company in Hyderabad that builds and runs business systems — Dealer Management, Clinic Management, School Management — and custom software for businesses that don't fit a template. It should feel precise, dependable, calm and human.
criteria: Success: keeps the cube-and-bot equity, reads at 16 px, works in one colour and reversed, feels like a systems company rather than a toy.

concepts.name: Bot in the box
concepts.idea: One silhouette: cube, eyes and antenna survive one colour and 16 px.
rationale: Keeps every piece of existing equity — cube, eyes, antenna, the Cubott pun
Three faces a seam apart: a system built from parts
Small-size cut for favicons; true one-colour and reversed versions

recommendation: Bot in the box — the current idea, drawn so it finally works everywhere.
next_steps: Roll out to website, app, documents
